minor.issue: Calls 154/1407 'players'. They are player-season entries (1561 entries over 7 seasons), although the source also uses 'players'.
'Injury data ... may lack mechanism and grade' is not a limitation the authors state.
Adds fit and compliance as uncontrolled factors. The authors do not raise these.
Advice to integrate the brace in practice so stance and footwork adapt is extrapolated; the study excluded practice settings.
Suggests a brace as a post-injury risk-management component, which the study did not examine.
Omits the 2015 season differences favouring non-bracers (overall and pass-block).

note: Both are faithful and appropriately non-causal. A gives exact counts, rates, grades and the 2015 exception, while B is vaguer and adds extrapolated practice and RTS advice.
